cases.query: Configure native reviewers with repository read tools only

relevant.source_excerpt:
fn native_args(max_turns: u32, role: NativeRole) -> Vec<String> {
    let mut args: Vec<String> = [
        "-p",
        "--input-format",
        "text",
        "--output-format",
        "stream-json",
        "--verbose",
        "--tools",
        match role {
            NativeRole::Executor | NativeRole::GuardedExecutor => "Read,Edit,Write,Grep,Glob,Bash",
            NativeRole::Reviewer => "Read,Grep,Glob",
        },
        "--permission-mode",
        role.permission_mode(),
        "--permission-prompts",
        "none",
        "--max-turns",
        &max_turns.to_string(),
        "--no-session-persistence",
        "--no-chrome",
    ]
    .iter()
    .map(|arg| (*arg).into())
    .collect();
    if role == NativeRole::Reviewer {
        args.extend(
            [
                "--safe-mode",
                "--restricted",
                "--strict-mcp-config",
                "--mcp-config",
                "{\"mcpServers\":{}}",
                "--disable-slash-commands",
                "--json-schema",
                REVIEW_OUTPUT_SCHEMA,
            ]
            .into_iter()
            .map(str::to_owned),
        );
    }
    args
}
relevant.reason: Reviewer tools are Read, Grep, and Glob; reviewer arguments add safe mode, restrictions, an empty strict MCP configuration, disabled slash commands, and an output schema.
